requirements.description: The user is looking for an existing school building, which corresponds to the 'Attività scolastiche' typology in the current physical state.
User wants the building to be located near green spaces. 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user requires energy class D or better, so the filter includes all classes from A1 down to D. The location requirement (near green spaces) is geographic and out of scope, and the school-building and nursery-conversion context is not an energy parameter, so no other filters are added.
